name: highlight
description: Show the player where things are, through walls, frames and terrain (1.7.0+), on the player's screen only (other players see nothing; nothing in the world changes; 1.12.0+ on a dedicated server the player's own game draws them, when it runs StationGod): targets [{...}] (up to 64), each exactly one of reference_id, reference_ids (up to 1024 things: devices, pieces, items, anything with a mesh), network_id (a cable, pipe or chute network, or any piece on it: every piece of it, up to 4096) or at ([x, y, z] metres: a far point), with color (cyan, magenta, yellow, green, orange, blue, red, white, or [r, g, b] 0 to 1; default the next of those in turn), label (text, up to 80 characters) and pulse (true: the tint swells once a second). Things are drawn with their own meshes as the game holds them (every part of a device, a frame at its build state), tinted, with the T-Ray SPU's own see-through material (SPUMesonScanner, the lens mode that shows pipes and cables through walls) or, without it, a built-in material with the depth test off; a label stands at the thing nearest the camera. A point gets a tall beam (wider with distance, so it stays seen from far off) and a label with its distance, bearing (degrees clockwise from north, +z; 90 is east, +x) and height difference; out of view, the label and a >> arrow sit at the screen's edge in the direction to turn. seconds (default 60, max 600); a new call replaces the last unless keep: true; clear: true only removes them. Returns targets [{index, kind (things, network, point), color, label, pulse, network_id, things (drawn), missing (ids naming nothing), truncated, at, distance_m, bearing_deg, compass, rise_m (from the camera to the point, or to the nearest thing)}], cleared, seconds, renderer (t-ray (shader) or built-in; remote when the player's own game draws), notes (only what this call needs said; 1.14.0+ no longer the fixed reminders), drawn_on (the player whose game drew them, when not this game) and view {source local|remote, age_s}. Refused: no_view, view_stale, network_not_found, no_network. Needs the player's view (distances are from its camera): the player's view (1.12.0+) is this game's own camera, or on a dedicated server the view the player's own StationGod sends (StationGod is optional on a player's machine; without it these calls refuse).

network_id.description: A cable, pipe or chute network, or any piece on it: every piece.

at.description: [x, y, z] or {x, y, z} in metres.

color.description: A colour name, or [r, g, b] 0 to 1. Default the next palette colour in turn.

label.description: Text shown at the target, up to 80 characters.

pulse.description: Default false. true: the tint swells once a second.

targets.description: Each exactly one of reference_id, reference_ids, network_id or at.

keep.description: Default false: a new call replaces what earlier calls drew.

clear.description: Only remove what is drawn; give nothing else.
